modules.name: core
modules.purpose: Posty5Options (incl. DefaultHeaders, CreatedFrom), Posty5HttpClient (X-Posty5-Client on every request, ResolveCreatedFrom, no retries), errors, response/pagination types, AgentOrigin, converters.

modules.name: account
modules.purpose: Posty5.Account: AccountClient - who the API key is (key, owner, plan, credits, MCP settings), credits, credit history and summary, live operation costs. Read-only.

modules.name: short-link
modules.purpose: Short-link list/get/create/update/delete; bulk create (CreateManyAsync), export, bulk jobs (ShortLinkClient.Bulk.cs).

modules.name: qr-code
modules.purpose: Create/update seven QR types plus get/list/delete; QRCodeTemplateClient lists user and public templates and (QD 4.1.0) creates/updates/gets/lists/deletes/renders designs, reads the design catalogue and uploads logos; QRCodeClient.Design.cs renders, signs export links and checks scannability; bulk create, export, bulk jobs with ZIP (QRCodeClient.Bulk.cs).

modules.name: webhooks
modules.purpose: Posty5.Webhooks: WebhookEndpointClient (/api/webhook-endpoints) and WebhookSignature.Verify (Standard Webhooks) with polymorphic WebhookEvent models.

modules.name: social-publisher-workspace
modules.purpose: Workspace CRUD/list and logo upload; SocialPublisherAccountClient reads connected social accounts (list/lookup/get, read-only).

modules.name: social-publisher-post
modules.purpose: Video/image/text/story publishing, post status (/{id}/status), reschedule, delete (unpublished) and remove (published) from platforms.
